answer: Admission runs a geo-diverse beacon check. Each epoch, three beacons - Onyx, Nebula, Comet - on different continents publish fresh signed nonces. A new identity must echo all three within RTT windows matching its claimed region; two-of-three plus median-RTT agreement grants write rights. Per-epoch nonces and VRF audits block precomputed replies. A sybil farm in one rack fails: light-speed delay forbids low RTT to three continents at once. Each of N puppets needs genuine presence in three regions - cost paid per puppet, no bulk discount - while an honest user pays once.
